summary: Fills the 16 consecutive floats starting at this + 1419 (offset 0x162C) with the uniformly spaced sequence 0.0, 0.0625, ..., 0.9375, computed as (double)v4 * 0.0625 for v4 = 0..15. Each computed value is passed to sub_5881F0 before being stored. Despite the packet ABI lead name (Float_Array_Init_with_Random), the source performs no randomization; it writes a fixed uniform step table.

local_names.v2: current element pointer, starts at this + 1419 and advances per iteration
local_names.v3: per-element computed value (double), stored as float
local_names.v4: copy of the loop counter used as the sequence index

operations.description: Initialize the loop counter v1 and its copy v4 to 0, and set v2 to this + 1419 (start of the 16-float array at offset 0x162C).
Repeat while v1 < 16, writing one element per iteration and advancing v2 and v1.
Compute v3 = (double)v4 * 0.0625; the packet lists the double constant dbl_5AC9C8 as a read global, which the existing analysis (DERIVED) identifies as this 0.0625 multiplier.
Pass the computed v3 to sub_5881F0 before it is stored.
Store v3 into the current element *v2 of the float array at offset 0x162C.
